name: Green Park Provincial Park Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 700 m frame) at 46.5903,-63.8907: RV pads in open fields and loops cut through mixed woods; the Trout River estuary pond lies ~300 m east behind a wooded strip and the river beach / red bank is ~400 m NW at the tent area; the riverfront sites the operator names are tent sites; default down - not waterfront

name: Confederation Trailside Tourist Grounds
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 46.3443,-62.9688: trailer rows and pool on open farmland north of Route 2 (pin moved ~190 m from the roadside Google pin onto the sites); no water in frame - not waterfront

name: Somers By The Beach Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 46.0222,-62.5591: site loops in mixed trees and open grass north of the gravel road (pin moved ~175 m from the entrance onto the sites); a river channel runs ~200 m east behind continuous woods and the beach of the name is not in frame; default down - not waterfront

name: Red Rock Retreat Campground & Cottages
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 46.4634,-63.3829: gravel site loops in a clearing between farm fields and woods (pin moved ~110 m east of the road onto the sites); no water in frame - not waterfront

name: Cumberland Cove Seaside Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 46.2170,-63.5738: open mown field with RV pads ~30 m back from the low red bank of the Northumberland Strait, nothing between the sites and the water but grass; within a site-depth of the shore -> open-apron bayfront (Northumberland Strait frontage used as bayfront in the Atlantic sweep)
